description: Search canonical task toolsets, compact user-intent routes, and the full Hive coverage catalog. Select a matching route first, follow its ordered primary calls and conditional fallbacks, then inspect each exact schema. Execute reads with invoke_api_endpoint and explicitly approved Hive state changes with invoke_stateful_endpoint.

category.description: Optional category filter, for example Portfolio & Wallet.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response.

detail.description: Toolset detail level. Defaults to compact. Use full only when the task output schema is needed.

evidence_phase.description: Optional exact workflow evidence phase. Supported values: activity, alerts, approvals, assets, authenticity, balances, blocks, bridges, derivatives, discovery, enrichment, evidence, fees, funding, gas, history, holders, identity, infrastructure, liquidity, logs, market, markets, memory, monitoring, ohlcv, owners, positions, reports, risk, routing, sales, schema, simulation, stablecoins, trades, transactions, tvl, yields.

provider.description: Optional provider filter such as CoinGecko, Tenderly, Helius, GoPlus, CCXT, Alchemy, DeFiLlama, Hyperliquid, or Open Data Fetch.

query.description: Search text matched against tool name, title, category, provider, and summary.

response_format.description: Output format: 'json' for structured data (default) or 'markdown' for human-readable text.

route_id.description: Optional exact task-shaped route id. Use the matched route's ordered calls and conditional fallbacks instead of choosing from the coverage catalog.

toolset_cursor.description: Pagination cursor for task toolset matches.

toolset_id.description: Optional exact canonical task toolset id. Use this after an initial compact result to inspect one workflow.

toolset_limit.description: Maximum matching task toolsets to return. Default 3, max 5.

name: search_tools

cache_age_ms.description: Milliseconds since Hive first observed the response. Zero means newly retrieved from the provider, not that the provider's underlying datum is current.

cause.description: Errors only: what actually happened, written for the model.

credit_cost.description: Static credit price of this tool: 0 for discovery tools and free writes, 1 for everything else. Present when the calling lane bills.

credits_remaining.description: Balance after this call: keyed credits, or keyless calls left today. null for unlimited plans; absent when the lane has no notion.

credits_used.description: Credits actually debited for this call: 0 when validation or a gate stopped it, credit_cost once the provider was reached.

doc_url.description: Docs anchor for the error code (errors only).

fallback_used.description: Present and true when a task-route fallback tool produced this response after the primary returned failing/missing_key. provider/tool name the actual executed source.

input_digest.description: SHA-256 self-check of canonical JSON arguments. It is not a server signature.

next_action.description: Errors only: the one useful next step. Follow it instead of retrying the same call unchanged.

observed_at.description: When Hive first observed this response. On a cache hit this is the original cache-population time; it is not necessarily the upstream datum's event time.

origin_source.description: Original upstream tier. Preserved as fallback when a fallback-tier response is later served from cache.

receipt_id.description: Unique runtime receipt for this Hive tool call. Include it when reporting or debugging the evidence.

result_digest.description: SHA-256 self-check of the canonical returned payload after Hive result normalization and before the top-level _hive receipt is attached.

sanitized.description: Present and true when instruction-shaped provider text was neutralized before reaching agent context.

availability.description: Live availability of this tool's provider from the cached health snapshot. missing_key/failing tools are ranked last and return runtime_status, not data.

material.description: True when the call costs one credit (or one keyless call); false for free discovery tools and free writes.

providerAvailability.description: Present only when a provider in this toolset is not ok: provider name -> degraded | missing_key | failing.

title: Search Tools
